# OOMOL Connector for DeepSeek Harness
Use OOMOL Connector Actions from DeepSeek Harness through progressive MCP discovery.
`dsh-oomol` supports OOMOL Hosted and self-hosted OpenConnector. One plugin instance connects to one
Connector endpoint.

## How it works
The plugin mounts DeepSeek Harness's Streamable HTTP MCP client with the selected Connector endpoint
. Connector Actions remain progressively discoverable, keeping the permanent Harness tool surface sm
nnector Actions remain progressively discoverable, keeping the permanent Harness tool surface small.
OOMOL Hosted stores Provider credentials in OOMOL Connector. Self-hosted deployments store them in O
penConnector. Harness stores only the Connector client key selected by `apiKeyEnv`.
The browser receives the credential reference and status metadata. Connector API keys and Provider c
redentials stay in Host-side secret boundaries.
See Architecture for implementation details.

## Security

- Store Connector API keys in Harness Credentials or the launch environment.
- Use HTTPS for remote

self-hosted endpoints.
- Review destructive, externally visible, permission-changing, and broad-shar

ing Actions before execution.
- Treat an ambiguous side-effecting call as an unknown outcome and ins

pect the Provider before retrying.
- Report vulnerabilities through SECURITY.md.
